latest.title: How to Architect a Secure 3-Tier Network on AWS with $0 NAT Gateway Costs
latest.description: A practical architectural guide for cloud students on designing isolated VPC subnets, Security Group chaining, and avoiding unexpected NAT Gateway charges on AWS Free Tier.

latest.title: Building Generative AI Applications with Amazon Bedrock
latest.description: Learn how Amazon Bedrock makes it easier to build generative AI applications using foundation models through AWS, without managing the underlying machine learning infrastructure.

latest.title: Production-Grade ECS Fargate: How to Architect Scalable, Zero-Downtime Microservices
latest.description: A practical guide to architecting isolated environments, zero-downtime rolling deployments, and automated CI/CD pipelines on AWS ECS Fargate with GitHub Actions and Terraform.

latest.title: Designing Enterprise-Grade LLM Agent Architectures on AWS: Security, Resilience, and Architectural Trade-Offs
latest.description: Why single-agent architectures fail in production and how to architect decoupled, least-privileged multi-agent systems on AWS. A deep architectural guide covering the Hierarchical Supervisor pattern, defense-in-depth security with VPC PrivateLink and Bedrock Guardrails, fault tolerance with circuit breakers, and concrete trade-off decisions (ADRs) for enterprise AI.

latest.title: Building a Cloud-Native DevOps Platform with CI/CD, Docker & Kubernetes
latest.description: Explore how a modern application moves from development to production using Docker, CI/CD, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and automated deployments. This article walks through the architecture, workflow, and key DevOps practices behind the platform.

latest.title: AWS Multi-Account Strategy Explained: Organizations, Control Tower and Cloud Governance
latest.description:
As AWS environments grow, managing everything inside a single AWS account can become difficult. A multi-account strategy helps organizations separate workloads, improve security, control access, simplify billing, and establish governance.

This article explains AWS Organizations, Organizational Units (OUs), Service Control Policies (SCPs), AWS Control Tower, account separation, centralized governance, and multi-account best practices using practical cloud infrastructure examples.
